## Goal
Once a month Free My ID can show one short notification (`maybe_monthly_progress`, `src/freemyid/notify.py:87-111`) with counts (requests sent, sites confirmed or no longer listing you, items waiting for you and, after WO-517, sites that put a listing back). Explain it in plain words: what each number means, why practice mode shows nothing, why it never names a site or a person, how to turn notifications off in Windows and on a Mac, and that nothing needs doing if it only shows counts. Quote the sentence shapes from `progress_body` (`notify.py:78-84`) as they are after WOs 512 and 517 merge.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Under 450 words, reading level grade 8 or lower.
2. Every sentence quoted from the toast matches the code after WO-512/517 (cite file:line in an HTML comment; re-check after those merge).
3. States that practice mode sends no monthly update and that the first month only starts the clock (`notify.py:98-103`).
4. Turning notifications off: Windows 10 and 11 steps by Settings name, macOS steps, and "Linux: your desktop's notification settings"; each step verified against the vendor's own help text cited by name only, no URLs unless the repo already cites them; say "not sure" for anything unverified.
5. Says plainly that the message never contains a name or a site and is counts only.
6. No "guarantee", "erase", "100%", "nothing is sent".
7. Linked from `docs/user/help-topics.md` by in-house after merge.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
